purpose: Descriptive synthesis of verified experiment artifacts and readiness audit for inferential statistics/manuscript claims.

phase6_resnet50_random_split.interpretation: Optimistic in-domain reference only; not field generalization evidence.

phase8_cross_dataset_shift.interpretation: External datasets have non-overlapping label spaces; label-match values are not class-accuracy estimates.

phase14_calibration.interpretation: Calibration result is in-domain and temperature was selected using validation NLL.

phase17_ood_detection.interpretation: Useful separation signal, but the operating point has substantial in-domain false-positive rate.

phase19_data_efficiency.interpretation: Large gains occur at low data fractions; the curve shows diminishing returns in this frozen-feature protocol.

phase20_model_family_compute.interpretation: EfficientNet-B0 is the descriptive accuracy/compute trade-off winner, without inferential evidence of superiority.

recommended_next_gate: Run a final reproducibility kernel that saves per-sample predictions and correctness for ResNet-50, MobileNetV3-Large, and EfficientNet-B0 under identical frozen splits; then compute paired bootstrap CIs and paired tests before manuscript drafting.
claim_boundary: Results support distribution-shift characterization and descriptive model/uncertainty comparisons, not causal attribution, farm-level validation, early-disease detection, or statistically significant backbone superiority.
